0.why: src/CFor2N2ForC.cpp process(): clamp(getVoltage(), -5.f, 10.f), a negative voltage is shifted up by 10V and only the fractional part is used
src/CFor2N2ForC.cpp process(): setVoltage(inCV), the knob value, knobs configured -5 to 10

1.why: src/CFor2N2ForC.cpp process(): setVoltage(10.f, i) for i in 0..11 and setChannels(12)

comment: The CV output is monophonic and the trigger output always carries exactly twelve channels whether or not anything is patched in. A negative input voltage is shifted up by 10V before the note is worked out, so the twelve zones line up the same way across the whole -5V to +10V span. The module does nothing at all with the CV jack empty, which the README does not say. Every input is read with getVoltage(), so a polyphonic cable is read on its first channel only.
